usedFor: SprintOps plans sprints and Asana receives tasks, so “When a new task is created” can fill “Create Task or Subtask”.

bestTemplate.name: “When a new task is created” in SprintOps, then “Create Task or Subtask” in Asana
bestTemplate.why: Each new sprint task appears in Asana with assignee, tags, dates and description.

watchOut: “When a task is updated” fires on every edit, so it can create a second task for the same work.
